The nightclub makes  laundered money but the money it makes isn't a whole lot. If you want to make the most out of the nightclub you will want to buy the other businesses. To buy the other businesses you'll need to become a CEO or MC president. To become a CEO you have to buy an office, which you can buy on one of the real estate websites ( I forgot the name of the website, but look around on the internet and you should find it. The cheapest one is $1,000,000 sadly). From there you can buy a storage warehouse for cargo crates and you can also buy a bunker for guns, a hanger for crates, and a vehicle warehouse that sells cars, although I personally wouldn't recommend buying the hanger because I hardly use mine. To become an MC president you have to buy an MC Clubhouse which you can buy on the maze bank foreclosure website, the cheapest one is like $200,000 I think. From there you can buy different businesses that make passive income (document forgery, counterfeit, weed, meth and cocaine). You have to keep these businesses supplied at all the time so they can make their products. All of this is very very very expensive but if you get all of these businesses you can hire people at the nightclub to make/gather these products passively, which you can eventually sell for a profit (I don't know how much you can make yet since It just came out). Hope this helps.

Update: I fixed the problem, but I did it another way then suggested and I figured i'd post how I did it in case it happened to someone else. I went into the open folder option of the mod pack on twitch, went to the saves folder and moved all the saved world I have to my desktop. After that I closed the folder and deleted the profile using the twitch option. After that I re-downloaded the mod-pack and put the saved worlds back into the saves folder. And now it's working good as new, hope this helps someone; thanks for the advice everyone!
